test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'has emerged'**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The context of the passage indicates that ongoing and increasing harm has become apparent because of the pandemic.
 
• The phrase "That harm 3________ as an unintended side effect..." needs to express a present perfect action (which started in the past and continues into the present).
 
• "**Has emerged**" is the most appropriate option as it uses the present perfect tense to indicate a process that started in the past and is still relevant.
 
• Other options like "**had emerged**", "**have emerged**", and "**was emerged**" do not fit well grammatically or contextually.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'has emerged'**.

 

Complete Passage: *2022 sees us entering a third year of the pandemic, and the harm * **done to**__ * children is increasingly evident: A record rise in child poverty. Setbacks to progress on * __**routine**__ * vaccinations. Disruption to education for entire generation. That harm * __**has emerged**__ * as an unintended side effect of the world's efforts to manage the crisis. COVID has been a uniquely dis-equalizing crisis. Lopsided * __**vaccines**__ * aside, learning losses have been greatest among poorest children, and job losses have been disproportionately borne by women and youth. What next for the world’s children in the year ahead? As in the past two years, prospects for children will continue to hinge * __**on**__ * the pandemic and how it is managed.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** __Additional Information__ ** 

 
• **Had emerged**: Incorrect because it is past perfect tense, which denotes an action completed before some other action in the past, which does not fit the context here.
 
• **Have emerged**: Incorrect because it is the present perfect tense for a plural subject, but "harm" is a singular noun.
 
• **Was emerged**: Incorrect because "emerged" is an intransitive verb and does not pair with "was" in the passive voice.
